title: Grilled Salmon Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for grilled salmon skewers, perfect for a summer evening. This dish is light and refreshing, making it ideal for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Thread a salmon piece, a few onion slices, and a few cherry tomatoes (if using) onto each skewer.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Brush the skewers with the marinade, making sure to coat all the ingredients.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the salmon is cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
